input.summary: Loop the yellow left spinner. Its return lights that spinner for 2x, so each spin scores 20,000. Build the stored FINISH multiplier and run it during Checkpoint hurry-ups.

steps.text: Test a full plunge and a short plunge. Confirm the left-spinner loop, right-inlane return, and which spinner is yellow.
modeNotes: Full plunge: It can cross the left spinner, enter the back-center kicker, and feed the right inlane. Some copies choke and fall back.
Short plunge: Gives the lower flippers earlier control when the full route is unsafe.

steps.text: When the left spinner is yellow, shoot it from the right flipper. Let the back-center kicker feed the right inlane.
modeNotes: Yellow spinner: Scores 10,000 per spin. The other spinner scores 500. Slings and selected switches alternate the yellow lamp.
Right inlane: Lights the left spinner white for about five seconds. Yellow plus white makes it worth 20,000 per spin.

steps.text: Use the right-inlane return to repeat the left spinner before the white 2x lamp ends. Keep looping while the feed stays controlled.
Hit each flashing FINISH standup. Complete all six to add one stored multiplier, up to 15x.
modeNotes: FINISH multiplier: It carries between balls. It does not run continuously.
When a Checkpoint hurry-up runs, the stored multiplier flashes and multiplies all playfield scoring except the hurry-up itself.

steps.text: Start the next Checkpoint hurry-up. During its approximately 25-second timer, repeat the 2x yellow spinner.
modeNotes: Checkpoint route, in order: middle-left rollunder, right-spinner back kicker, upper-right orbit, left inlane, lower-right target, lower-left target, right inlane, and left-spinner Finish Line.
First-race hurry-ups start at 100,000 times the next Checkpoint number. After one race, every Checkpoint hurry-up starts at 800,000.
An expired hurry-up does not block progress. Make the required Checkpoint to advance and start the next timer.

steps.text: Repeat races and FINISH sets. Keep the spinner as the scoring priority whenever yellow, white 2x, and the timed playfield multiplier overlap.

fallback.title: Checkpoint hurry-ups
fallback.when: Use this when the left-spinner loop rejects or the yellow lamp stays on the right spinner.

steps.text: Follow the eight flashing Checkpoints in order.
Collect each hurry-up while its value remains high.
Use upper-playfield routes to collect Checkpoints 2 through 4.
After one race, repeat the route with 800,000 starting hurry-ups.

alternatives.title: Crossover ball save
alternatives.when: Use this when extra balls are enabled or converted to 500,000 and the center-left crossover shot is controlled.

steps.text: Shoot the center-left crossover to collect its displayed 50,000, 100,000, 150,000, and 200,000 awards in order.
The 200,000 shot lights extra ball at the crossover and upper right orbit.
A crossover extra ball locks the current ball. Plunge a replacement. The locked ball ejects only after that replacement drains.
Complete FINISH sets until the stored multiplier reaches 15x.
Complete one race so later Checkpoint hurry-ups start at 800,000.
During every timed multiplier window, loop the 2x yellow spinner.

techniques.name: Left-spinner repeat loop
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left spinner from the right flipper. Use the back-kicker and right-inlane feed to return to the same flipper for another shot.

techniques.name: Checkpoint 2 upper feed
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left ramp. Hold the upper-right flipper and let the ball leave the upper playfield with speed toward the right-spinner back kicker.

techniques.name: Shooter-lane save
techniques.instruction: When a right-side ball approaches the open shooter-lane gap, nudge it into the shooter lane for a replunge.

techniques.name: Rolling Shatz for checkpoint alignment
techniques.instruction: When a controlled feed reaches the wrong flipper, use a moving-ball Shatz transfer to change sides without first trapping. Continue only when the next checkpoint shot is already lined up.

cautions.issue: A full plunge can stall near the left spinner and fall back unpredictably.
cautions.response: Test the first full plunge. Use a short plunge when the intended orbit-to-kicker path does not complete.

cautions.issue: A crossover extra ball ejects the stored ball immediately after the replacement ball drains.
cautions.response: Stay at the machine and keep both flippers ready after the drain. Do not turn away for the bonus count.

cautions.issue: The right side has an open path to the shooter lane rather than a normal closed outlane wall.
cautions.response: Nudge early toward the shooter-lane opening. Replunge any saved ball with the safer plunge.

playfieldReferences.context: Standups used to complete the race.

input.simpleOverview: In stock Victory, shoot the left spinner while its yellow lamp is on, let the back-center kicker feed the right inlane, then repeat the spinner while its white 2x lamp is also on. Complete flashing F-I-N-I-S-H targets to store a multiplier, and repeat the spinner while that multiplier runs during each Checkpoint hurry-up.
input.overview: In stock Victory, the yellow left spinner scores 10,000 per spin, and the right inlane lights it for 2x for about five seconds. Repeat that spinner loop, complete flashing F-I-N-I-S-H targets to store up to 15x, then use each Checkpoint hurry-up to run the stored multiplier on the spinner. Follow all eight Checkpoints to finish a race and raise later hurry-ups.
